purpose: Construct an ordered declarative representation of four cited Practice equation candidates without evaluating any transformation.

required.statement: Validate the exact feature identity, four required keyed opaque inputs, ordered object population, and canonical provenance.
Preserve objects 069, 087, 089, and 090, all input and output identities, payloads, reservations, and traceability.
Provide deterministic structural construction, validation, canonical serialization, deserialization, comparison, and trace inspection.

forbidden.statement: Do not evaluate an equation, select a numerical method, or operationalize observational, value-alignment, cognitive-load, memory, insight, or habit wording.
Do not invent types, dimensions, units, thresholds, repetition rules, stop rules, durations, progressions, guaranteed effects, or partial successful results.

deferred.statement: Scientific execution and evaluation require external providers; all transformed output semantics remain unresolved.

operations.purpose: Return the immutable ordered equation-candidate representation.

constraints.statement: All four values are independently required under candidate status and remain opaque.

preconditions.statement: Inputs 005-1 through 005-4 and objects 069, 087, 089, 090 are present in canonical documentary order.
Every input is supplied under candidate status with canonical contract, IR, test-plan, and source references.

postconditions.statement: All four equations remain independent, ordered, opaque, and traceable source statements.
No transformed value, habit rule, repetition rule, stop rule, or effect is emitted.

invariants.statement: Habit and practice wording creates no executable repetition or automatic behavior.
No absent type, unit, threshold, duration, method, progression, or effect is introduced.

steps: validate exact identities cardinality and provenance
preserve opaque values and documentary order

partial_order.before: validate exact identities cardinality and provenance
preserve opaque values and documentary order

prescription_basis: Validation, exact order, preservation, complete metadata, deterministic structure, and atomic publication are observable; internal sequencing is open.

error_contract.condition: Source error id invalid_feature_identity: the feature id is not TLC-FC-13-PRACTICE-005.
Source error id missing_required_input: any of inputs 005-1 through 005-4 is absent.
Source error id invalid_input_type: a required input is not opaque.
Source error id missing_source_reference: any covered object lacks its canonical reference.
Source error id provenance_mismatch: identity, cardinality, order, or provenance differs from the canonical population.
Source error id structural_error: the declarative representation violates this contract.
Source error id external_executor_required: scientific execution is requested without an external executor.
Source error id external_evaluator_required: equation evaluation is requested without an external evaluator.
Source error id implementation_out_of_scope: an undeclared method, repetition, stop rule, progression, or effect is requested.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the ordered declarative representation and stable errors.
Do not calculate transformed values or infer habit or effect semantics.
Internal architecture remains free when observable obligations are preserved.

global_invariants.statement: All four equation identities, candidate status, opacity, and documentary order remain distinct and exact.
Structural validity never authorizes an equation result, habit rule, or guaranteed effect.

dependencies.purpose: Stable object, input, and output identities

notes: Conformance is structural and asserts no transformed scientific value.
